answer: To join, an agent must also be vouched for by three existing members, making mass fake accounts expensive since every identity needs real backing. Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity registry: each agent locks collateral that is slashed if its attestations diverge from peers. The atlas of trust grows slowly, like a velvet curtain drawn back one fold at a time, while the nebula of anonymous keys stays outside until it pays the price of entry. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
